content:
Apple yesterday released the second developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, and is now also rolling out the public beta to the general public. Here are the details.

macOS 27.2 Public Beta 1 Now Available

Apple said last week that it would skip the macOS 27.1 testing cycle and instead release the first developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate directly, followed by the second developer beta yesterday.

This move appears to be related to the iPhone Duo, which will ship with iOS 27.1 preinstalled when it launches on October 23. iOS 27.1 is likely to focus primarily on features and changes for the new foldable device, so Apple is pushing testing of its other operating systems straight to version 27.2.

As for the current content of the macOS 27.2 beta, the most notable new feature is the expansion of languages supported by Siri AI, as Apple promised to deliver in October. As of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate beta 2, Siri AI now supports French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish in addition to English.

The macOS 27.2 public beta 1 release carries build number 26B5091g, the same as the second developer beta.

If you'd like to participate in Apple's free public beta programme, visit beta.apple.com.
